title: Reese scores 30 as Dream stun Valkyries to level WNBA finals
summary: Angel Reese scored a game-high 30 points as the Atlanta Dream defeated the Golden State Valkyries 79-65 to level their best-of-seven WNBA Finals series on Monday.
